messages:
Ava: Quick thread: we need a long-term approach to stitch late-arriving billing/tenant attributes for cost attribution. Two contenders: an event-sourced correlation ledger (durable, queryable) or a lightweight mapping service + ephemeral caches. Thoughts?
Tom: Ledger wins for auditability & deterministic replays. We can make it append-only and compaction-friendly (columnar blobs per day). Downside is storage + cross-region join complexity.
Leila: Mapping service approach reduces storage but pushes complexity into the analytics join and replay pipelines. Also harder to prove historical state for audits.
Nikhil: Operational constraints: cannot add sync wall to main ingest. Any ledger writes must be async and non-blocking. Also prefer a hot-path bypass so traces with billing attrs skip extra work.
Ava: Agree. Proposal variant: event-sourced ledger that only records "miss events" (when billing/tenant attrs absent). That minimizes writes. Ledger entries are tiny (trace_id + missing_attr_type + ingest_ts + source_region).
Tom: Perf note: current ingest ~14k traces/s/region on peak. If miss rate is 6%, ledger write QPS ~840/s. With 30B compressed entries -> ~2.2GB/day/region. 5d retention -> ~11GB before compaction. Reasonable.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: snapshot: ingest rate sample (2026-03-22T02:15Z) shows regional p95 13.8k tps, p99 16.4k tps.
Leila: Important: reconciliation window design. If we allow a 24-48h window to materialize final attribution, dashboards must reflect provisional vs final cost. Need a pipeline tagging model.
Nikhil: Also guardrails: if ledger backlog grows, reconciliation should prioritize recent spans and raise alerts. Compaction should dedupe trace_id writes so repeated misses for same trace don't bloat storage.
Ava: Implementation sketch: (1) At ingest, check billing attrs. (2) If missing -> emit miss-event to local append queue (fast), ack immediately. (3) Async writer batches to ledger shards (per-region) with sequence numbers. (4) Periodic reconciler consumes ledger, queries attribute sources (metadata service, billing resolver), writes final attribution into analytics store and emits audit records.
Tom: Storage format idea: per-shard daily files with LZ4 blocks + tombstones for compaction. Keep an index of trace_id -> offset for fast lookups during reconciliation.
Leila: For cross-region duplicates, reconciliation should prefer first-seen from authoritative region and mark others as duplicates. Need idempotent reconciler semantics.
Nikhil: SLOs: ledger append must not add >5ms p50 to local ack path (we're async so should be <1ms). Reconciler end-to-end should aim to settle >90% at 24h, 99% at 72h.
Ava: Action list: Tom -> prototype append writer + compaction sim. Leila -> reconciliation runner spec (duplicate handling + audit outputs). Nikhil -> alerting & SLO docs + retention policy. I'll draft a decision addendum to the observability RFC.
Tom: I'll also run cost sims with different miss rates (1%,5%,10%) and share numbers.
Leila: UX note: analytics team needs a "finalized_at" field in cost tables and a flag for provisional entries so dashboards can show drift.
Ava: Perfect. If POC numbers look good we'll land hybrid default: ledger-on-miss + hot-path bypass. Meeting Fri 11am to review PoC. :rocket:
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: ledger-append-POC namespace created (2026-03-22T03:00Z).
Nikhil: Add watch: ledger writer backpressure, compaction lag >1h, reconciliation error rate >0.5% -> pager.
Ava: Closing for now. RFC addendum incoming with owners and timeline.
